definitions.explanation: An egg cooked by boiling in water. Includes both soft-boiled and hard-boiled eggs.

examples.japanese: ゆで{卵|たまご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
ゆで{卵|たまご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{殻|から}をむく→殻をむく：20430_karawomuku⟧。
⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{半熟|はんじゅく}→半熟：11935_hanjuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ゆで{卵|たまご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦トッピング→トッピング：17674_toppingu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I added a soft-boiled egg as a topping on my ramen.

notes:
WRITING:
Also written as {茹|ゆ}で{卵|たまご}. The hiragana-kanji mixed form ゆで{卵|たまご} is most common.

TYPES:
- ⟦{半熟|はんじゅく}→半熟：11935_hanjuku⟧ゆで{卵|たまご} — soft-boiled egg
- {固|かた}ゆで{卵|たまご} — hard-boiled egg
- ⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦{付|つ}き→付き：26333_tsuki⟧ゆで{卵|たまご} — seasoned boiled egg (like {煮卵|にたまご})

CULTURAL NOTE:
Boiled eggs are a standard ramen topping ({味玉|あじたま}) and a classic convenience store item in Japan. ⟦{温泉卵|おんせんたまご}→温泉卵：27857_onsentamago⟧ (hot spring egg) is a related but different preparation.
